Calculates road network route, distance, polyline, and predicted ETA.

Falls back gracefully to straight-line distance with explicit 'unavailable' status
and no invented ETA if road routing providers fail.

schema.description: Optional routing provider: osrm, google, mapbox, straight_line

get.description:
Calculates road network route, distance, polyline, and predicted ETA.

Falls back gracefully to straight-line distance with explicit 'unavailable' status
and no invented ETA if road routing providers fail.

parameters.name: provider

schema.description: Optional routing provider: osrm, google, mapbox, straight_line
schema.title: Provider

parameters.description: Optional routing provider: osrm, google, mapbox, straight_line

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds. null/None when routing provider is unavailable (distance only)

polyline.title: Polyline
polyline.description: List of [latitude, longitude] coordinates representing the route geometry

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Routing provider used: osrm, google, mapbox, straight_line

status.title: Status
status.description: 'available' when road network routing succeeded; 'unavailable' when fallback straight-line was used

straight_line.title: Straight Line
straight_line.description: True if route is straight-line distance only without road navigation or ETA

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Human readable route summary, e.g. '14 mins (6.2 km)' or 'distance only, no ETA'

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: Whether this result was served from Redis cache

error.title: Error
error.description: Error explanation if routing provider failed
